title: Gust of Wind
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: A new 3rd-level spell for clerics, druids and rangers of air: Gust of Wind, a blast of desert wind a square wide and a square long per level of the caster. Everyone in it who fails a Strength check is blown 2 squares away from the caster and loses the rest of the round, and it blows away the clouds and fog it reaches (Stinking Cloud, Wall of Fog, Dust Cloud, Cloudkill). It uses Dust Devil's icon and look. Off: the game has only the original's spells.
